# OSS Knowledge Base Update Proposal

## Methodology
- Normalize duplicate PYSEC/GHSA entries sharing the same CVE into single canonical records.
- All findings are strictly evidence-backed from the gathered advisory data.
- Current PyPI versions used to determine whether latest releases are affected.

---

## 1. gunicorn (current: 26.0.0)

### Deduplication

| Canonical ID | Aliases | Deduplicate |
|---|---|---|
| CVE-2018-1000164 | GHSA-32pc-xphx-q4f6, PYSEC-2018-55 | Merge into **one** record |

### Consolidated Vulnerability Records

| # | Canonical CVE | GHSA | PYSEC | Title | Fixed In | Affects Current? |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | CVE-2018-1000164 | GHSA-32pc-xphx-q4f6 | PYSEC-2018-55 | CRLF Injection in HTTP headers | 19.5.0 | **No** (26.0.0 ≥ 19.5.0) |
| 2 | CVE-2024-1135 | GHSA-w3h3-4rj7-4ph4 | — | HTTP Request Smuggling via chunked transfer-encoding | 22.0.0 | **No** (26.0.0 ≥ 22.0.0) |
| 3 | CVE-2024-6827 | GHSA-hc5x-x2vx-497g | — | HTTP Request/Response Smuggling | 22.0.0 | **No** (26.0.0 ≥ 22.0.0) |

**KB Update:** Merge GHSA-32pc-xphx-q4f6 and PYSEC-2018-55 into a single record under CVE-2018-1000164. Add Debian/Ubuntu references from PYSEC-2018-55 (DSA-4186, USN-4022-1, DLA) to the merged record. Note that CVE-2024-1135 and CVE-2024-6827 share the same fix PR (#3113) and fix version (22.0.0), but are distinct vulnerabilities covering different smuggling vectors.

**Status:** All three known CVEs are resolved in current release 26.0.0. No open vulnerabilities.

---

## 2. uvicorn (current: 0.46.0)

### Deduplication

| Canonical CVE | GHSA | PYSEC | SNYK | Deduplicate |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| CVE-2020-7694 | GHSA-33c7-2mpw-hg34 | PYSEC-2020-150 | SNYK-PYTHON-UVICORN-575560 | Merge into **one** record |
| CVE-2020-7695 | GHSA-f97h-2pfx-f59f | PYSEC-2020-151 | SNYK-PYTHON-UVICORN-570471 | Merge into **one** record |

### Consolidated Vulnerability Records

| # | Canonical CVE | Aliases (all) | Title | Fixed In | Affects Current? |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | CVE-2020-7694 | GHSA-33c7-2mpw-hg34, PYSEC-2020-150, SNYK-…-575560 | Log injection via CRLF in request path | 0.11.7 | **No** (0.46.0 ≥ 0.11.7) |
| 2 | CVE-2020-7695 | GHSA-f97h-2pfx-f59f, PYSEC-2020-151, SNYK-…-570471 | HTTP response splitting via CRLF in header values | 0.11.7 | **No** (0.46.0 ≥ 0.11.7) |

**KB Update:** Collapse each GHSA+PYSEC+SNYK triplet into a single canonical CVE record. Add fix commit `895807f` (from GHSA) to the CVE-2020-7694 merged record. Note repository migration from `encode/uvicorn` → `Kludex/uvicorn` (current `Source` URL); update canonical repo link accordingly.

**Status:** Both known CVEs are resolved in current release 0.46.0. No open vulnerabilities.

---

## 3. flask-cors (current: 6.0.2)

### Deduplication

| Canonical CVE | GHSA | PYSEC | Deduplicate |
|---|---|---|---|
| CVE-2020-25032 | GHSA-xc3p-ff3m-f46v | PYSEC-2020-43 | Merge into **one** record |
| CVE-2024-6221 | GHSA-hxwh-jpp2-84pm | PYSEC-2024-71 | Merge into **one** record |

### Consolidated Vulnerability Records

| # | Canonical CVE | Aliases | Title | Severity | Fixed In | Affects Current? |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | CVE-2020-25032 | GHSA-xc3p-ff3m-f46v, PYSEC-2020-43 | Directory traversal in CORS resource matching | High | 3.0.9 | **No** |
| 2 | CVE-2024-1681 | GHSA-84pr-m4jr-85g5 | Log injection when log level is DEBUG | Low | 4.0.1 | **No** |
| 3 | CVE-2024-6221 | GHSA-hxwh-jpp2-84pm, PYSEC-2024-71 | `Access-Control-Allow-Private-Network` set to true by default | Medium | 4.0.2 | **No** |
| 4 | CVE-2024-6839 | GHSA-7rxf-gvfg-47g4 | Improper regex path matching bypasses CORS policy | Medium | 6.0.0 | **No** |
| 5 | CVE-2024-6844 | GHSA-8vgw-p6qm-5gr7 | Inconsistent CORS origin matching | Medium | 6.0.0 | **No** |
| 6 | CVE-2024-6866 | GHSA-43qf-4rqw-9q2g | Case-sensitivity bypass in origin matching | Medium | 6.0.0 | **No** |

**KB Updates:**
- Merge GHSA-xc3p-ff3m-f46v + PYSEC-2020-43 → single CVE-2020-25032 record. Add openSUSE advisory refs from PYSEC-2020-43.
- Merge GHSA-hxwh-jpp2-84pm + PYSEC-2024-71 → single CVE-2024-6
